title: Moving Inventory Checklist
subtitle: Household Moving Inventory: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Moving Inventory Checklist covers inventory item, carton, room, handling instruction, custody event, and destination placement. The move coordinator records Household Moving Inventory criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Moving Inventory Checklist keeps Household Moving Inventory exceptions visible until the move coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Moving Inventory Checklist at origin residence, vehicle, storage point, destination, and room placement. Document inventory item, carton, room, handling instruction, custody event, and destination placement identity before Household Moving Inventory begins. Compare inventory item, carton, room, handling instruction, custody event, and destination placement findings with stated Household Moving Inventory criteria; route unresolved Household Moving Inventory issues to moving operations reviewer. For Moving Inventory Checklist, confirm requirements for Household Moving Inventory. Ask moving operations reviewer to review Household Moving Inventory conditions beyond the move coordinator's role.

sections.title: Inspector, location, and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Household Moving Inventory, identify responsible parties, origin residence, vehicle, storage point, destination, and room placement, and the linked inventory item, carton, room, handling instruction, custody event, and destination placement source.

fields.label: Origin, destination, dates, and access window
Item, carton, tag, room, and declared special-handling identity

sections.title: Checklist points, conditions, and actions
sections.guidance: Capture Household Moving Inventory facts for inventory item, carton, room, handling instruction, custody event, and destination placement; include result, limit, source, and next control.

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

blocks.label: Household Moving Inventory inspection checks
items: Item count, description, and origin room
Fragile, high-value, disassembled, or restricted handling
Carton, seal, tag, load position, and custody transfer
Delivery count, placement, assembly, and condition
Shortage, damage, refusal, or unlocated item

sections.title: Inspection exception, restriction, and reinspection
sections.guidance: Use observed Household Moving Inventory evidence to state disposition. Keep limits visible and give Move Coordinator both correction and repeat-check responsibility.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Access or weight requires different equipment
Damage or shortage requires preservation and escalation
blocks.guidance: Pause Household Moving Inventory when a prohibited-item, access, equipment, custody, shortage, or damage exception remains unassigned. Retain the available Household Moving Inventory proof and route unresolved inventory item, carton, room, handling instruction, custody event, and destination placement scope to move coordinator.
